# Standards

The core checks and implemented vendor contracts, with their stated authority.
The vendor inventory is generated from manifests. Specification coverage and
remaining requirements are reviewed separately in RULEPACK_DEPTH_AUDIT.json.

## Evidence levels

| Level | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `normative` | A formal standard: WHATWG, W3C, IETF |
| `official_vendor` | A parameter contract the vendor publishes, cited by URL |
| `official_template` | Vendor-published templates or SDK behavior |
| `ecosystem_reference` | Consistent real-world behavior the vendor generates but does not document |
| `heuristic` | Pixellint's own judgment |

The manifest loader rejects any rule that claims `official_vendor` without a
documentation URL. Vendors change endpoints without notice; when a contract
cannot be verified in published documentation, the rule is demoted rather than
dressed up.

## `core`

Applies to every URL-like artifact: `url`, `vast`, `postback`, `request`, and
`unknown`. A `json` artifact, or an `unknown` one that opens like a document,
gets the syntax check instead.

| Standard | Enforced | Rule ids | Level |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [WHATWG URL Standard](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/) | The artifact parses as an absolute URL and carries a host | `core.url.invalid`, `core.url.host_missing` | normative |
| [W3C Beacon](https://www.w3.org/TR/beacon/) | Network-delivered artifacts use `http` or `https` | `core.url.unsupported_scheme` | normative |
| [RFC 3986](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3986) | No embedded credentials; fragments never reach the server | `core.url.userinfo_deprecated`, `core.url.fragment_ignored` | normative |
| Secure transport baseline | Plain `http` endpoints are flagged for upgrade | `core.url.insecure_transport` | best practice |
| Input baseline | Empty artifacts are rejected before URL checks run | `core.input.empty` | heuristic |
| [RFC 8259](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8259) | A JSON body parses, and the finding names the byte where it stops | `core.json.parse_error` | normative |
| Macro handling | A fired URL carries no unresolved macros; macros never sit in scheme, authority, host, port, or userinfo; one artifact uses one macro syntax, except a VAST tracker that pairs IAB `[MACRO]` with `${MACRO}` | `core.macro.unexpanded_in_fired_url`, `core.macro.unsafe_position`, `core.macro.mixed_syntax`, `core.macro.broken_delimiter` | heuristic |
| [IAB VAST macros](https://iabtechlab.com/standards/vast/) | On `vast` artifacts, a `[TOKEN]` is a published IAB name, spelled in uppercase. `[CONTENTPLAYHEAD]` and `[MEDIAPLAYHEAD]` are the pre-4.1 names for `[ADPLAYHEAD]` | `core.macro.vast_unknown`, `core.macro.vast_lowercase`, `core.macro.vast_deprecated` | normative |

Macro rules recognize `[NAME]`, `${NAME}`, `{{NAME}}`, `{NAME}`, `%%NAME%%`, `!!NAME!!`,
and `[%NAME%]`. They are deliberately generic: per-vendor macro vocabularies
belong in vendor packs. The IAB name check runs only on `vast` artifacts and
only on `[TOKEN]` brackets, because a pixel URL uses the same brackets for
vendor tokens. `%%NAME%%`, `!!NAME!!`, and `[%NAME%]` count as macros for the
fired-URL check and for the privacy-signal skip. A VAST tracker may carry
`[CACHEBUSTING]` beside `${AUCTION_PRICE}` without a mixed-syntax warning.
`!!GDPR!` (one bang short) and a bare `FT_GDPR` value are `core.macro.broken_delimiter`.

### Consent and privacy signals

IAB Tech Lab specifies these parameters, every party in the chain is expected to
carry them, and the failure modes do not vary by vendor, so they are `core`
rules rather than vendor ones. They are read from the query string and from
Floodlight-style path parameters.

The strings are decoded, not just pattern-matched. Base64 is a permissive
alphabet: `gdpr_consent=1` and `gdpr_consent=true` are both well-formed base64
segments, and both pass any check that only looks at characters. What separates
a consent string from a string is the fields the specs fix.

| Field read | Spec says | Rule id |
| --- | --- | --- |
| TC String Version, first 6 bits | "the value is 2 for this format" | `core.privacy.tc_string_version` |
| TC String core segment length | The fields through PublisherCC need 213 bits, so 36 characters is the floor | `core.privacy.tc_string_truncated` |
| US Privacy version, first character | Version 1 is the only one published | `core.privacy.us_privacy_version` |
| GPP header type, first 6 bits | "Fixed to 3 as GPP Header field" | `core.privacy.gpp_header_type` |
| GPP header version, next 6 bits | Currently 1; unknown versions produce an advisory | `core.privacy.gpp_header_version` |
| TC String variable sections | Complete vendor vectors/ranges, publisher restrictions, optional segments and dated disclosure requirement | `core.privacy.tc_string_sections_invalid` |
| TC String policy fields | Current scope, purpose basis and known timestamp rules, with source conflicts preserved as advisories | `core.privacy.tc_string_policy_warning` |
| GPP header and sections | Header ID/count correspondence and published TCF, Canada, USP and 21 US layouts | `core.privacy.gpp_sections_invalid` |
| GPP opaque layouts | Unknown section IDs or major versions remain explicitly unvalidated | `core.privacy.gpp_sections_unvalidated` |
| GPP field definitions | Published notice/choice dependencies and conflicting legacy encoders produce advisories | `core.privacy.gpp_policy_warning` |

A TCF v1 string decodes to version 1 and is reported as sunset rather than as
malformed, since it is a real consent string that no v2 vendor can read. A TC
String pasted into `gpp` decodes to header type 2 and is reported as such,
because putting the right string in the wrong parameter is the commonest way to
get this wrong.

Applicable IDs are checked against the GPP header's encoded section list.
`gpp_sid` carries the section IDs in force for the current transaction,
and may select a subset of the encoded sections. It does not need to repeat
every header ID.

| Standard | Enforced | Rule ids | Level |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [TCF v2](https://github.com/InteractiveAdvertisingBureau/GDPR-Transparency-and-Consent-Framework/blob/master/TCFv2/IAB%20Tech%20Lab%20-%20Consent%20string%20and%20vendor%20list%20formats%20v2.md) | `gdpr` is `0` or `1` | `core.privacy.gdpr_invalid` | normative |
| TCF v2 | `gdpr=1` is accompanied by a TC String | `core.privacy.gdpr_consent_missing` | normative |
| TCF v2 | A TC String without a `gdpr` flag leaves the callee guessing | `core.privacy.gdpr_consent_without_flag` | normative |
| TCF v2 | A TC String is only meaningful when `gdpr=1` | `core.privacy.gdpr_consent_ignored` | normative |
| TCF v2 | The TC String is URL-safe base64 | `core.privacy.gdpr_consent_malformed` | normative |
| [US Privacy](https://github.com/InteractiveAdvertisingBureau/USPrivacy/blob/master/CCPA/US%20Privacy%20String.md) | The string is a version digit and three `Y`, `N`, or `-` characters | `core.privacy.us_privacy_malformed` | normative |
| US Privacy | The signal was deprecated on 31 January 2024 in favor of GPP | `core.privacy.us_privacy_deprecated` | normative |
| [GPP](https://github.com/InteractiveAdvertisingBureau/Global-Privacy-Platform/blob/main/Core/Consent%20String%20Specification.md) | The GPP string is URL-safe base64 with `~` between sections | `core.privacy.gpp_malformed` | normative |
| GPP | `gpp` is accompanied by the section IDs in force | `core.privacy.gpp_sid_missing` | normative |
| [GPP CMP API](https://github.com/InteractiveAdvertisingBureau/Global-Privacy-Platform/blob/main/Core/CMP%20API%20Specification.md) | The applicable section list contains at most two IDs; `-1` alone indicates none | `core.privacy.gpp_sid_malformed` | normative |
| GPP | Applicable IDs must be present in the encoded header | `core.privacy.gpp_sid_sections_mismatch` | normative |
| TCF v2, GPP | Each signal appears only once in a URL | `core.privacy.duplicate_signal` | normative |

Two deliberate exemptions keep these rules quiet where trafficking is correct:
a value carrying an unexpanded macro is the macro rules' business, and an empty
value is an unfilled template slot, which is how Floodlight and VAST tags ship
before an ad server populates them.

## `vendor/adobe-analytics`

## `vendor/adobe-ecid`

Direct Visitor ID Service calls to dpm.demdex.net/id. Adobe documents d_ver=2 as required, and either d_orgid to mint an ECID or d_mid to reuse one. Audience Manager /event and cookie sync on cm.everesttech.net are not contracted.

## `vendor/amazon-ads`

Amazon Ad Tag conversion loader on s.amazon-adsystem.com/iu3/conversion, whose Tag ID rides in the path. APS apstag.js is not contracted. Firefly viewability hops are vendor/amazon-vfw.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/amazon-ads.json).

Matcher: `{"hosts":["s.amazon-adsystem.com"],"path_contains":["/iu3/conversion/"]}`.

Path captures: `/iu3/conversion/(?<advertiser_id>[^/]+)\.js`. Captured values take precedence over query keys with the same name.

### URL parameters

| Field | Requirement | Implemented checks | Authority |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `advertiser_id` | required | `{"format":{"kind":"non_empty"}}` | [ecosystem_reference](https://github.com/amzn/ads-pao-amznjs-gtm-template) |

## `vendor/amazon-vfw`

Amazon DSP Firefly viewability hops on vfw.amazon-adsystem.com /dv/, which wrap DoubleVerify measurement. Generated /dv/event.png and /dv/proxy tags always send vstevt. Generated /dv/proxy tags also send ctx, cmp, plc, and sid from the same dvparams Google documents on DoubleVerify wrappers. IAS /ias/ hops on the same host are not contracted. The Ad Tag loader is vendor/amazon-ads.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/amazon-vfw.json).

Matcher: `{"hosts":["vfw.amazon-adsystem.com"],"path_contains":["/dv/"]}`.

### URL parameters

| Field | Requirement | Implemented checks | Authority |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `vstevt` | required | `{"format":{"kind":"non_empty"}}` | [ecosystem_reference](https://advertising.amazon.com/resources/ad-policy/approved-3p-ad-servers) |
| `ctx` | optional | `{"format":{"kind":"non_empty"}}` | [ecosystem_reference](https://support.google.com/displayvideo/answer/2591756) |
| `cmp` | optional | `{"format":{"kind":"non_empty"}}` | [ecosystem_reference](https://support.google.com/displayvideo/answer/2591756) |
| `plc` | optional | `{"format":{"kind":"non_empty"}}` | [ecosystem_reference](https://support.google.com/displayvideo/answer/2591756) |
| `sid` | optional | `{"format":{"kind":"non_empty"}}` | [ecosystem_reference](https://support.google.com/displayvideo/answer/2591756) |

## `vendor/amplified`

Published VAST and complete inspected SDK tuple columns. Producer advisories preserve opaque metadata, open future telemetry labels, and the explicit ignore batching marker.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/amplified.json).

Matcher: `{"hosts":["pixel.amplified.co"],"path_prefixes":["/v1/vast/launch/","/v1/vast/event/","/v1/js/launch/","/v1/js/event/"]}`.

Path captures: `^/v1/(?P<transport>vast\|js)/(?P<action>launch\|event)/(?P<organization>[^/]+)/(?P<campaign>[^/]+)/prove/(?P<insertion_order>[^/]+)/(?P<line_item>[^/]+)/(?P<session_id>[^/]+)/?$`. Captured values take precedence over query keys with the same name.

## `vendor/appsflyer-impression`

Single-platform impression links on impression.appsflyer.com/{app_id}, with the shared published attribution parameter table, GET request method and S2S user-agent agreement. Account state, platform attribution and historical engagement correlation require additional context.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/appsflyer-impression.json).

Matcher: `{"hosts":["impression.appsflyer.com"]}`.

Path captures: `^/(?<app_id>[^/?]*)/?$`. Captured values take precedence over query keys with the same name.

## `vendor/appsflyer-onelink-impression`

OneLink long impression URLs with the full published attribution parameter table, device hash variants, redirects, viewability and cross-platform windows. Account-dependent attribution and app behavior remain contextual.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/appsflyer-onelink-impression.json).

Matcher: `{"hosts":["impressions.onelink.me"]}`.

Path captures: `^/(?<template_id>[^/?]+)$`. Captured values take precedence over query keys with the same name.

## `vendor/appsflyer`

Server-to-server in-app events posted to api3.appsflyer.com/inappevent, including the JSON event payload.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/appsflyer.json).

Matcher: `{"hosts":["api3.appsflyer.com"],"path_contains":["/inappevent/"],"json_paths":[{"any_of":["appsflyer_id","eventName"]},{"path":"identity","excludes":".+"},{"path":"event","excludes":".+"}]}`.

Path captures: `/inappevent/(?<app_id>[^/?]*)`. Captured values take precedence over query keys with the same name.

### URL parameters

| Field | Requirement | Implemented checks | Authority |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `app_id` | required | `{"format":{"kind":"non_empty"}}` | [official_vendor](https://dev.appsflyer.com/hc/reference/s2s-events-api3-overview) |

| Rule | Assertion and condition | Severity | Authority |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `vendor.appsflyer.ios_app_id_unprefixed` | `{"kind":"forbid_value_pattern","pattern":"^[0-9]+$","params":["app_id"]}` | warning | [official_vendor](https://dev.appsflyer.com/hc/reference/s2s-events-api3-overview) |

## `vendor/awin-basket`

Awin product-level tracking requests on www.awin1.com/basket.php and zenaps.com/basket.php. Each product_line is one AW:P row. Conversion pixels stay vendor/awin. The MasterTag stays vendor/awin-mastertag.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/awin-basket.json).

Matcher: `{"hosts":["www.awin1.com"],"host_suffixes":["zenaps.com"],"path_prefixes":["/basket.php"]}`.

### URL parameters

| Field | Requirement | Implemented checks | Authority |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `product_line` | required | `{"format":{"kind":"regex","pattern":"^AW:P\\\|[0-9]+\\\|[^\|]+\\\|[^\|]+\\\|[^\|]+\\\|[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?\\\|[1-9][0-9]*\\\|[^\|]*\\\|[^\|]+\\\|[^\|]*$"}}` | [official_vendor](https://help.awin.com/developers/docs/product-level-tracking-2) |

## `vendor/awin-mastertag`

Awin Advertiser MasterTag on www.dwin1.com/{advertiserId}.js. Conversion pixels on www.awin1.com are vendor/awin.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/awin-mastertag.json).

Matcher: `{"hosts":["www.dwin1.com"],"path_contains":[".js"]}`.

Path captures: `/(?<advertiser_id>[^/.]+)\.js`. Captured values take precedence over query keys with the same name.

### URL parameters

| Field | Requirement | Implemented checks | Authority |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `advertiser_id` | required | `{"format":{"kind":"integer"}}` | [official_vendor](https://help.awin.com/developers/docs/advertiser-mastertag) |

## `vendor/awin`

Awin fall-back conversion image and S2S reads on www.awin1.com/sread.img and /sread.php, including product-level bd[n] rows and custom pN keys. Product-level basket.php requests are vendor/awin-basket. The MasterTag on www.dwin1.com is vendor/awin-mastertag.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/awin.json).

Matcher: `{"hosts":["www.awin1.com"],"path_prefixes":["/sread.img","/sread.php"]}`.

## `vendor/cloudflare`

Cloudflare Web Analytics beacon on static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js. GTM and query installs put the site token on the URL. Automatic injection puts it in data-cf-beacon instead. POST /cdn-cgi/rum is not contracted.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/cloudflare.json).

Matcher: `{"hosts":["static.cloudflareinsights.com"],"path_contains":["beacon.min.js"]}`.

| Field | Requirement | Implemented checks | Authority |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `token` | recommended | `{"format":{"kind":"non_empty"}}` | [official_vendor](https://developers.cloudflare.com/web-analytics/faq/) |
| `spa` | optional | `{"format":{"kind":"enum","values":["true","false","0","1","2"]}}` | [official_template](https://static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js) |

## `vendor/doubleverify`

DoubleVerify impression beacons on tps.doubleverify.com/visit.jpg and tpsc-video-*.doubleverify.com/visit.jpg. Google documents ctx, cmp, plc, and sid on the generated FlashTalking and DoubleVerify wrapper as dvparams. Those names ride on visit.jpg. Generated video wrappers also send vstevt on visit.jpg. Quartile event.png hops are vendor/doubleverify-event. OMID dvtp_src.js, RTB, and VAST wrappers are not contracted. Amazon-hosted /dv/ hops stay vendor/amazon-vfw.

| `cmp` | required | `{"format":{"kind":"non_empty"}}` | [ecosystem_reference](https://support.google.com/displayvideo/answer/2591756) |

## `vendor/flashtalking-state`

Five-part state tracker recognized by official Innovid Tag Assistant 1.1.5 on legacy Flashtalking servedby hosts. Numeric tuple fields and a nonempty impression identifier are template completeness advisories. The recognizer does not establish server rejection, event enumeration or session correctness.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/flashtalking-state.json).

Matcher: `{"hosts":["servedby.flashtalking.com","servedby-us.flashtalking.com","servedby-eu.flashtalking.com","servedby-emea.flashtalking.com"],"path_prefixes":["/state/"]}`.

Path captures: `^/state/(?<placement_id>[^;/?]*);(?<creative_id>[^;/?]*);(?<version_id>[^;/?]*);(?<event_id>[^;/?]*);(?<impression_id>[^/?]*)/?$`. Captured values take precedence over query keys with the same name.

### URL parameters

| Field | Requirement | Implemented checks | Authority |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `placement_id` | recommended | `{"format":{"kind":"regex","pattern":"^[0-9]+$"},"severity":"warning"}` | [official_template](https://help.innovid.com/hc/en-us/articles/28042598512284-Innovid-Tag-Assistant-User-Guide) |
| `creative_id` | recommended | `{"format":{"kind":"regex","pattern":"^[0-9]+$"},"severity":"warning"}` | [official_template](https://help.innovid.com/hc/en-us/articles/28042598512284-Innovid-Tag-Assistant-User-Guide) |
| `version_id` | recommended | `{"format":{"kind":"regex","pattern":"^[0-9]+$"},"severity":"warning"}` | [official_template](https://help.innovid.com/hc/en-us/articles/28042598512284-Innovid-Tag-Assistant-User-Guide) |
| `event_id` | recommended | `{"format":{"kind":"regex","pattern":"^[0-9]+$"},"severity":"warning"}` | [official_template](https://help.innovid.com/hc/en-us/articles/28042598512284-Innovid-Tag-Assistant-User-Guide) |
| `impression_id` | recommended | `{"format":{"kind":"non_empty"},"severity":"warning"}` | [official_template](https://help.innovid.com/hc/en-us/articles/28042598512284-Innovid-Tag-Assistant-User-Guide) |

## `vendor/flashtalking`

Flashtalking OneTag Spotlight containers on servedby.flashtalking.com/container/{advertiserId};{spotlightId};{spotlightGroupId};. The three IDs ride in the path. Tealium documents that generated snippet shape. Other Flashtalking hosts are not contracted.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/flashtalking.json).

Matcher: `{"hosts":["servedby.flashtalking.com"],"path_contains":["/container/"]}`.

Path captures: `/container/(?<advertiser_id>[^;]*);(?<spotlight_id>[^;]*);(?<spotlight_group_id>[^;]*);`. Captured values take precedence over query keys with the same name.

| `spotlight_id` | required | `{"format":{"kind":"integer"}}` | [ecosystem_reference](https://docs.tealium.com/client-side-tags/flashtalking-onetag-tag/) |
| `spotlight_group_id` | required | `{"format":{"kind":"integer"}}` | [ecosystem_reference](https://docs.tealium.com/client-side-tags/flashtalking-onetag-tag/) |

## `vendor/google-ads-call-conversions`

## `vendor/google-ads-conversion`

Google Ads conversion and view-through conversion image pixels, whose conversion ID rides on the path.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/google-ads-conversion.json).

Matcher: `{"host_suffixes":["googleadservices.com","googleads.g.doubleclick.net"],"path_contains":["/pagead/conversion","/pagead/viewthroughconversion"]}`.

Path captures: `/pagead/(?:viewthrough)?conversion/(?<conversion_id>[^/?]*)`. Captured values take precedence over query keys with the same name.

| `label` | recommended | `{"format":{"kind":"non_empty"}}` | [official_vendor](https://support.google.com/tagassistant/answer/2947038) |
| `value` | optional | `{"format":{"kind":"regex","pattern":"^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$"}}` | [official_vendor](https://support.google.com/tagassistant/answer/2947038) |
| `currency_code` | optional | `{"format":{"kind":"regex","pattern":"^[A-Za-z]{3}$"}}` | [official_vendor](https://support.google.com/tagassistant/answer/2947038) |
| `ord` | optional | `{"format":{"kind":"non_empty"}}` | [official_vendor](https://support.google.com/tagassistant/answer/2947038) |
| `guid` | optional | `{"format":{"kind":"enum","values":["ON"]},"format_severity":"warning"}` | [official_vendor](https://support.google.com/tagassistant/answer/2947038) |
| `script` | optional | `{"format":{"kind":"enum","values":["0"]},"format_severity":"warning"}` | [official_vendor](https://support.google.com/tagassistant/answer/2947038) |

Identify is vendor/heap-identify. Add user properties is vendor/heap-user-properties. Classic heap-{id}.js is vendor/heap-classic.

## `vendor/impact-conversions`

Server-to-server conversion submissions to api.impact.com/Advertisers/{AccountSID}/Conversions. The UTT loader is vendor/impact.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/impact-conversions.json).

Matcher: `{"hosts":["api.impact.com"],"path_contains":["/Conversions"]}`.

Path captures: `/Advertisers/(?<account_sid>[^/]+)/Conversions`. Captured values take precedence over query keys with the same name.

## `vendor/kwai`

Kwai Pixel loader on s1.kwai.net, whose Pixel ID rides as sdkid. Kwai documents kwaiq.load(pixelId) rather than this query.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/kwai.json).

Matcher: `{"hosts":["s1.kwai.net"],"path_contains":["/pixel/"]}`.

### URL parameters

| `sdkid` | required | `{"format":{"kind":"non_empty"}}` | [ecosystem_reference](https://docs.qingque.cn/d/home/eZQCNZ1wBFnEpQEAMmOhfoVwI?identityId=1pTerwwOjbg) |
| `lib` | recommended | `{"format":{"kind":"enum","values":["kwaiq"]},"format_severity":"warning"}` | [ecosystem_reference](https://docs.qingque.cn/d/home/eZQCNZ1wBFnEpQEAMmOhfoVwI?identityId=1pTerwwOjbg) |

## `vendor/linkedin`

LinkedIn conversion image pixels on px.ads.linkedin.com/collect. Campaign Manager generates pid, conversionId, and fmt. eventId is the dedup key LinkedIn documents on the image URL. oid is the Path to Conversion order ID. url is the conversion match URL when conversionId is absent. Insight Tag page-load fires omit conversionId. CAPI stays vendor/linkedin-conversions-api.

## `vendor/lotame`

Lotame Lightning Tag on tags.crwdcntrl.net/lt/c/{clientId}/lt.min.js. The client ID rides in the path as an integer. bcp.crwdcntrl.net collect is not contracted.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/lotame.json).

Matcher: `{"hosts":["tags.crwdcntrl.net"],"path_contains":["/lt/c/"]}`.

Path captures: `/lt/c/(?<client_id>[^/]*)/lt\.min\.js`. Captured values take precedence over query keys with the same name.

### URL parameters

| Field | Requirement | Implemented checks | Authority |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `client_id` | required | `{"format":{"kind":"integer"}}` | [official_vendor](https://my.lotame.com/t/83hxvnt/lt-js-basic-implementation) |

## `vendor/mailchimp`

Mailchimp connected-site loader attribution on chimpstatic.com/mcjs-connected/js/users/{user}/{site}.js. The Connected Sites API returns a site_script URL but does not publish a complete HTTP contract for this route. list-manage.com forms are not contracted.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/mailchimp.json).

Matcher: `{"host_suffixes":["chimpstatic.com"],"path_contains":["/mcjs-connected/js/users/"]}`.

Path captures: `/mcjs-connected/js/users/(?<user_id>[^/]+)/(?<site_id>[^/]*)\.js`. Captured values take precedence over query keys with the same name.

### URL parameters

| Field | Requirement | Implemented checks | Authority |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `user_id` | required | `{"format":{"kind":"non_empty"}}` | [ecosystem_reference](https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/api/connected-sites/add-connected-site/) |
| `site_id` | required | `{"format":{"kind":"non_empty"}}` | [ecosystem_reference](https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/api/connected-sites/add-connected-site/) |

## `vendor/matomo`

Matomo single and bulk HTTP Tracking API requests to matomo.php or piwik.php, including self-hosted endpoints. The pinned PHP8 bulk profile models scalar parse_str key normalization, last-value shadowing and mapped field readers. Bracket trees, sanitizer-sensitive values and runtime-dependent query forms remain explicitly unvalidated.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/matomo.json).

Matcher: `{"host_suffixes":["matomo.cloud"],"any_host":true,"paths":["/matomo.php","/piwik.php"]}`.

## `vendor/microsoft-uet`

Universal Event Tracking requests to the Microsoft Advertising collection endpoint. Microsoft documents ti, ver, evt, mid, and rn on every event, plus pageLoad kl and tw, custom-event pagetype, prodid, search_term, ecomm_category, transaction_id, and items, ecommerce ecomm_pagetype, ecomm_prodid, ecomm_totalvalue, and ecomm_query, and flight_destid, flight_originid, flight_pagetype, flight_startdate, flight_enddate, and flight_totalvalue.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/microsoft-uet.json).

## `vendor/mouseflow`

Mouseflow project script on cdn.mouseflow.com/projects/{website_id}.js.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/mouseflow.json).

Matcher: `{"hosts":["cdn.mouseflow.com"],"path_contains":["/projects/"]}`.

Path captures: `/projects/(?<website_id>[^/]+)\.js`. Captured values take precedence over query keys with the same name.

### URL parameters

| Field | Requirement | Implemented checks | Authority |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `website_id` | required | `{"format":{"kind":"non_empty"}}` | [official_vendor](https://help.mouseflow.com/en/articles/4312070-custom-variables) |

## `vendor/oracle-bluekai`

Oracle BlueKai site tags on tags.bluekai.com/site/{siteId} and stags.bluekai.com/site/{siteId}. The site ID rides in the path. Oracle documents the ID swap tag on stags. The JS Return tag uses the same path on tags. CoreTag on tags.bkrtx.com is not contracted.

## `vendor/parsely-collect`

Parse.ly tracker beacons on p1.parsely.com and p1-irl.parsely.com. The tracker loader on cdn.parsely.com is vendor/parsely.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/parsely-collect.json).

Matcher: `{"hosts":["p1.parsely.com","p1-irl.parsely.com"]}`.

## `vendor/parsely`

Parse.ly tracker loader on cdn.parsely.com/keys/{site_id}/p.js, whose Site ID rides in the path. Collect on p1.parsely.com is vendor/parsely-collect.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/parsely.json).

Matcher: `{"hosts":["cdn.parsely.com"],"path_contains":["/keys/"]}`.

Path captures: `/keys/(?<site_id>[^/]+)/p\.js`. Captured values take precedence over query keys with the same name.

### URL parameters

| Field | Requirement | Implemented checks | Authority |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `site_id` | required | `{"format":{"kind":"non_empty"}}` | [official_vendor](https://docs.parse.ly/installation-resources/parsely-integration/tracking-code-setup/) |

## `vendor/partnerize`

Partnerize S2S conversion URLs on prf.hn/conversion. Root basket fields and every independently bracketed item are validated, including optional vertical metadata. Campaign configuration and attribution history remain external.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/partnerize.json).

Matcher: `{"hosts":["prf.hn"],"path_prefixes":["/conversion"]}`.

## `vendor/pinterest-conversions-api`

Server-side conversion events posted to api.pinterest.com/v5/ad_accounts/{ad_account_id}/events.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/pinterest-conversions-api.json).

Matcher: `{"hosts":["api.pinterest.com"],"path_contains":["/ad_accounts/","/events"],"json_paths":[{"any_of":["data[].event_name","data[].event_id"]},"data[].action_source",{"path":"data[].action_source","excludes":"^(email\|website\|app\|phone_call\|chat\|physical_store\|system_generated\|business_messaging\|other\|WEB\|OFFLINE\|MOBILE_APP)$"}]}`.

Path captures: `/v5/ad_accounts/(?<ad_account_id>[^/]+)/events`. Captured values take precedence over query keys with the same name.

## `vendor/reddit`

Reddit Pixel conversion requests to alb.reddit.com/rp.gif. Reddit documents standard event names on rdt('track'). The query spelling event is ecosystem evidence. CAPI v3 stays vendor/reddit-conversions-api.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/reddit.json).

Matcher: `{"hosts":["alb.reddit.com"],"path_prefixes":["/rp.gif"]}`.

### URL parameters

| Field | Requirement | Implemented checks | Authority |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | required | `{"format":{"kind":"non_empty"}}` | [ecosystem_reference](https://business.reddithelp.com/s/article/Install-the-Reddit-Pixel-on-your-website) |
| `event` | recommended | `{"format":{"kind":"enum","values":["PageVisit","ViewContent","Search","AddToCart","AddToWishlist","Purchase","Lead","SignUp","Custom"]},"format_severity":"warning"}` | [ecosystem_reference](https://business.reddithelp.com/s/article/manual-conversion-events-with-the-reddit-pixel) |
| `m.customEventName` | optional | `{"format":{"kind":"regex","pattern":"^.{1,64}$"},"allow_empty":true}` | [ecosystem_reference](https://business.reddithelp.com/s/article/manual-conversion-events-with-the-reddit-pixel) |

| Rule | Assertion and condition | Severity | Authority |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `vendor.reddit.custom.requires_name` | `{"kind":"required_when_value","when":"event","equals":["Custom"],"requires":["m.customEventName"]}` | error | [ecosystem_reference](https://business.reddithelp.com/s/article/manual-conversion-events-with-the-reddit-pixel) |

## `vendor/rudderstack`

HTTP Tracking API JSON on the data plane, and Pixel API GET /pixel/v1/track. Self-hosted data planes on other hosts are directory-only.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/rudderstack.json).

Matcher: `{"hosts":["hosted.rudderlabs.com"],"host_suffixes":["dataplane.rudderstack.com","rudderlabs.com"],"path_contains":["/pixel/v1/track"],"json_paths":[{"any_of":["context.library.name","batch[].context.library.name"]},{"any_of":["event","batch[].type","batch[].event"]},{"path":"writeKey","excludes":"^.+$"},{"path":"api_key","excludes":"^.+$"},{"path":"distinct_id","excludes":"^.+$"}],"paths":["/v1/identify","/v1/track","/v1/page","/v1/screen","/v1/group","/v1/alias","/v1/batch","/v1/identify/","/v1/track/","/v1/page/","/v1/screen/","/v1/group/","/v1/alias/","/v1/batch/"]}`.

## `vendor/singular`

Server-to-server EVENT requests to s2s.singular.net/api/v1/evt and /api/v2/evt, as form or query parameters. JSON bodies are not this API.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/singular.json).

Matcher: `{"hosts":["s2s.singular.net"],"path_contains":["/api/v1/evt","/api/v2/evt"]}`.

Path captures: `^/api/(?P<api_version>v[12])/evt$`. Captured values take precedence over query keys with the same name.

## `vendor/snapchat`

Server-side event requests to the Snapchat Conversions API v3 events endpoint, including the JSON event payload.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/snapchat.json).

Matcher: `{"hosts":["tr.snapchat.com"],"path_contains":["/events"],"json_paths":["data[].event_name",{"path":"data[].action_source","excludes":"^(email\|website\|app\|phone_call\|chat\|physical_store\|system_generated\|business_messaging\|other\|web\|app_android\|app_ios\|offline)$"}]}`.

## `vendor/taboola-s2s-bulk`

Taboola bulk server-to-server conversions posted to trc.taboola.com/{account-id}/log/3/bulk-s2s-action. Single postbacks are vendor/taboola-s2s. The base pixel loader is vendor/taboola.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/taboola-s2s-bulk.json).

Matcher: `{"hosts":["trc.taboola.com"],"path_contains":["/bulk-s2s-action"],"json_paths":["actions"]}`.

Path captures: `/(?<account_id>[^/]+)/log/3/bulk-s2s-action`. Captured values take precedence over query keys with the same name.

## `vendor/taboola-s2s`

Taboola server-to-server conversion postbacks on trc.taboola.com/actions-handler/log/3/s2s-action. The base pixel loader is vendor/taboola. Bulk submit is vendor/taboola-s2s-bulk. Browser collect on the same host is not contracted.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/taboola-s2s.json).

## `vendor/taboola-unip`

Taboola browser event pixels on /log/3/unip. Taboola documents the en event name on the query. Generated pixels send revenue, currency, quantity, and orderid under those same names. The tfa.js loader is vendor/taboola. S2S postbacks are vendor/taboola-s2s.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/taboola-unip.json).

Matcher: `{"host_suffixes":["taboola.com"],"path_contains":["/log/3/unip"]}`.

### URL parameters

| Field | Requirement | Implemented checks | Authority |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `en` | recommended | `{"format":{"kind":"non_empty"}}` | [official_vendor](https://developers.taboola.com/pixel/docs/verification-network-traffic) |
| `revenue` | optional | `{"format":{"kind":"regex","pattern":"^-?[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?$"}}` | [official_vendor](https://developers.taboola.com/pixel/docs/track-dynamic-conversion-values) |
| `currency` | optional | `{"format":{"kind":"enum","values":["AUD","BRL","CAD","CNY","EUR","GBP","HKD","ILS","INR","JPY","KRW","MXN","NZD","RUB","SGD","THB","TRY","USD","ZAR"]}}` | [official_vendor](https://developers.taboola.com/pixel/docs/track-dynamic-conversion-values) |
| `quantity` | optional | `{"format":{"kind":"regex","pattern":"^-?[0-9]+$"}}` | [official_vendor](https://developers.taboola.com/pixel/docs/track-dynamic-conversion-values) |
| `orderid` | optional | `{"format":{"kind":"non_empty"}}` | [official_vendor](https://developers.taboola.com/pixel/docs/track-dynamic-conversion-values) |

## `vendor/taboola`

Taboola base pixel loader on cdn.taboola.com/libtrc/unip, whose numeric account ID rides in the path. Browser events are vendor/taboola-unip. S2S postbacks are vendor/taboola-s2s. Bulk submit is vendor/taboola-s2s-bulk.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/taboola.json).

Matcher: `{"hosts":["cdn.taboola.com"],"path_contains":["/libtrc/unip/"]}`.

Path captures: `/libtrc/unip/(?<account_id>[0-9]+)/tfa\.js`. Captured values take precedence over query keys with the same name.

### URL parameters

| Field | Requirement | Implemented checks | Authority |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account_id` | required | `{"format":{"kind":"integer"}}` | [official_vendor](https://developers.taboola.com/pixel/docs/add-the-base-pixel-manually) |

## `vendor/tiktok`

TikTok Pixel loader on analytics.tiktok.com/i18n/pixel/events.js and analytics.us.tiktok.com/i18n/pixel/events.js. TikTok generates sdkid and lib=ttq. Collect POST /api/v2/pixel is not contracted. Events API stays vendor/tiktok-events-api.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/tiktok.json).

Matcher: `{"hosts":["analytics.tiktok.com","analytics.us.tiktok.com"],"path_contains":["/i18n/pixel/events.js"]}`.

| `lib` | recommended | `{"format":{"kind":"enum","values":["ttq"]},"format_severity":"warning"}` | [ecosystem_reference](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/get-started-pixel) |

## `vendor/triplelift-sync`

Published TripleLift xuid, getuid and sync parameter contracts. Partner dongles, redirect allowlists, geographical applicability and browser cookies require external context.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/triplelift-sync.json).

Matcher: `{"hosts":["eb2.3lift.com"],"paths":["/xuid","/getuid","/sync"]}`.

Path captures: `^/(?<route>xuid\|getuid\|sync)$`. Captured values take precedence over query keys with the same name.

Documented TC String aliases: `["cmp_cs"]`. Core recognizes these only for a matching selected endpoint and validates every literal carrier.

## `vendor/yahoo-conversions-api`

Server-side events posted to batch.datax.yahoo.com/v1/events/{pixelId}. The pixel ID rides in the path. Dot image pixels stay vendor/yahoo-dot. Product CAPI, which requires eventId, is not contracted.

Manifest: [source](../crates/pixellint-core/rulepacks/vendor/yahoo-conversions-api.json).
